pages.note: redirects (301) to calendar.austinchronicle.com/austin/EventSearch?eventSection=2163369&sortType=date&v=g -- the citywide Music category listing (1,692 results, ~40/page, page 1 of 43 at fetch time). Too broad and unpaginatable-by-venue to page through fully in this budget; instead scraped per-venue via each venue's own 'LocationEvents?oid=<id>' page, found from each venue's /location/ page.

One page per venue (17 of 18 venues have a Chronicle location record); most venues' event lists ran 2+ pages (~20 events/page) -- 8 of the busier venues were read through page 2, the rest through page 1 only. Curl alone hits a Cloudflare challenge page ('Just a moment...', HTTP 403) on this domain; firecrawl (JS-rendered) was required.

coverage.why: The Chronicle calendar paginates at roughly 14-30 events per venue page. Only Stubb's had its second page actually fetched (34 events across both pages); every other venue was read from page 1 only, even where a 'page 2' link was visible in that page's markup -- so most venues' listings here stop somewhere in October-November 2026 and understate what the source actually has scheduled further out (e.g. Moody Amphitheater's page 1 alone happened to include an April 2027 jazz-festival booking, but that is a lucky outlier, not evidence the rest of the calendar was covered to that date). This is a real, acknowledged gap: coverage.complete is false, and lastDateReached should be read as 'the latest date that happened to appear on the pages fetched,' not a per-venue guarantee. 'Parish' and 'Summit' are separate edge cases, explained in their own perVenue entries.

cityWide.note: The citywide Music-category search reported '1,692 results, page 1 of 43' at fetch time (2026-09-24) -- but that figure is ALL Music-tagged listings across the whole Chronicle coverage area (Austin plus San Marcos, Dripping Springs, etc, and recurring listings counted per-occurrence), not scoped to our 17 venues or to a 30-day window, so it is not usable as a 'next 30 days' count without a lot more filtering than this task's budget allowed.

linkBehavior: Every 'Get Tickets' button on a Chronicle event or venue page is AFFILIATE-TAGGED when the underlying ticketer is Ticketmaster: the link routes through ticketmaster.evyy.net (an Impact Radius / Awin-style affiliate redirect network) with query params utm_medium=affiliate&sharedid=austinchronicle&subId1=austinchronicle before landing on the real ticketmaster.com event page -- example: https://ticketmaster.evyy.net/c/1202638/271177/4272?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ticketmaster.com%2Fjane-remover-live-exhibit-austin-texas-09-29-2026%2Fevent%2F3A006496118EB1BC&utm_medium=affiliate&sharedid=austinchronicle&subId1=austinchronicle. A minority of Ticketmaster links (mostly ones the Chronicle's system auto-generated as a bare search query rather than a specific event page) go straight to ticketmaster.com/search with no affiliate wrapper. Non-Ticketmaster ticketers (AXS, Etix, Eventim/Eventvesta, Eventbrite, venue-direct) are NOT wrapped -- those links go straight to the ticketer's own domain. The Chronicle's own /event/<slug> pages are its real 'source event page' (what we put in each event's url field); the outbound buy link is a separate ticketUrl field.
